post.heading: I Want to Create a Good Tool
post.p: The Hangprinter Project does not have well a defined scope or budget. There are no clear start- and end-points. So I can't fully wrap Hangprinter in the kind of structured project- and design-documents I learned about in school. I can still have something to help me make decisions though, by answering common questions, like:
post.h3: Why do you want to do this project?
post.p: I want to create a good tool.

I want people to arrive at the Hangprinter Project and realize they can use it to solve problems, big and small. And then I want it to actually work for them, of course. Solving problems makes people happy.
